name: medchain
description: MedChain — secure telemedicine with encrypted storage, IPFS hosting and blockchain-verified record integrity.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix blockchain install
scripts.//start: Single server on port 80 serving the built app and the API.
scripts.start: npm run build && npm --prefix backend run start:site
scripts.//dev: Two processes: Vite on 80 proxying /api to Express on 5000.
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test:unit && npm --prefix blockchain test
scripts.test:all: npm --prefix backend run test:all && npm --prefix blockchain test
scripts.//site: Always-on mode: starts the whole stack detached, so it outlives this terminal.
